items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I did know a fella named Freddie, Freddie Hall. He played the drums.

ctx.x: Did you know any of the other fellas in the band?

Oh, now, I know Louis. And then, I did know a fella named Freddie, Freddie Hall. He played the drums. He's from here, big stuff, Tubby. You heard of Tubby? Yeah, sure. Well, I remember Tubby. And another boy, his name is, he played the, he's from here. Now, what is his name? Oh, let me see. He plays in some of the leading bands. Now, I don't, I can't remember his name just now, but I remember Tubby, and I remember Lil, and Louis, and Oliver. Those are all I can remember right now that were in the band at that time.
Before the tape machine was on, you mentioned this fella, Kepler?
